title: TAT-3848 — category pills wrap at popup width instead of hiding
description: Proves the redesign at the width that motivated the review: on the narrow side-panel surface every category pill is still on screen, wrapped onto a second line, with no horizontal scroller and no More menu.

gate-cdp-reachable.intent: Refuse to report proof unless the live extension is actually attached

setup-unlock-wallet.intent: Get past the lock screen so the proof is taken on the real wallet UI

setup-open-market-list.intent: Move to the market list at the narrow width a popup user actually sees

setup-wait-market-list.intent: Hold until the category rail is on screen with its live categories

assert-forex-pill-visible.intent: The last category is on screen even at popup width, where the old build pushed it into the More menu

assert-no-overflow-menu.intent: Narrowing the window no longer produces a More control

clear-capture-orphans.intent: Keep the upcoming capture on the real screenshot provider instead of a silent fallback

screenshot-narrow-rail.label: Market list at popup width: the pills wrap onto a second line, all seven still visible
screenshot-narrow-rail.intent: Show the reader that a narrow window wraps the rail instead of hiding categories
